🚀 browserytools | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a private, convenient, and free suite of browser-based tools for everyday tasks like image editing, file conversion, and AI-powered content processing, all without requiring any uploads or account creation.
✨ Key Features: • 152+ browser-based tools • Client-side processing (no uploads, no accounts, no ads, no tracking)
📖 Summary: BrowseryTools is a collection of 152 free, browser-based utility tools built with Next.js and TypeScript. All file and text processing happens client-side, ensuring privacy with no uploads, accounts, or ads. It includes various tools like image manipulation, PDF converters, and on-device AI functionalities powered by Transformers.js.
